title: ILM Living-Standard Entry
description: One construct, in one language, bound to one institutional standard. The base seed layer is generator-produced; the review layer is community-governed. Generator output is a CORRECT REVERSIBLE DEFAULT, never a final idiomatic claim.

construct_id.description: Stable id of the universal construct, e.g. KW_STRUCT, KW_KERNEL.

language.description: ISO 639 code of the target language, e.g. hin, ben, ara.

layer.description: 9-Layer AGI stack layer this construct authors at.

paradigms.description: Computational paradigms this construct manifests in. A construct may appear in several; paradigm lists are NON-SUMMABLE (orthogonal primitives recur across paradigms).

native.description: Native-script keyword. May be 'romenagri_pending_<script>' placeholder for non-parallel scripts whose glyph rendering is not yet filled.

romenagri_ed.description: Romenagri-ED ASCII-7 identifier. Reversible. MUST be C-identifier-legal.

maps_into.description: The institutional specification this identifier maps INTO. ILM does NOT author or modify these.

clause.description: Optional clause/section reference within the standard.

governance.description: Honest governance class. de-jure = ISO/IEEE/IETF/W3C; de-facto = community-stabilized (e.g. Rust, ONNX); proprietary = single-vendor (e.g. CUDA); academic = research spec (e.g. Raft); unstandardized = no governing spec (e.g. cognitive architectures).

pedagogy.description: The 'Informed Pedagogy' layer: explains what the underlying spec construct DOES, in localizable terms. Every statement here must be factual about the named standard; no invented mechanics.

operational_mechanic.description: What the construct does at the target layer (e.g. 'allocates a contiguous aggregate with members at defined offsets').

safety_constraints.description: Memory boundaries, thread-safety, verification constraints the spec imposes.

localized_explanation.description: The mechanic re-expressed in the target language's idiom. Native-speaker-authored; generator leaves this empty by default.

pedagogy_source.description: Citation to the standard clause the mechanic is drawn from. Required if operational_mechanic is non-empty.

provenance.description: How this native form was produced. Generator defaults are tatsama/borrowed/pending; community review elevates to community-revised.

review_state.description: Community governance state. The generator seeds 'default'; native speakers move it forward.

status.description: default = generator seed, unreviewed. endorsed = native-speaker peer-approved. contested = competing idiomatic proposals exist.

reviewers.description: Reviewer handles/credentials. No personal data beyond a chosen handle.

alternatives.description: Competing idiomatic proposals for the same construct in the same language.
